put.description: Set the user's preferred organization workspace (path `me` for the session user, or a user id the caller may access). Send `{"organizationId":null}` to switch to personal — refused when the personal workspace is missing. Omitting the key (`{}`) is 422, not a personal switch. Setting an organization requires the user to be a member of it; the membership check and the write happen in one transaction.

get.description: Resolve the workspace to restore using the same rules as web sign-in: the saved organization when membership still exists, otherwise personal when available, otherwise the first remaining organization. This read does not update the saved preference or an active session. Check workspace-access first: null means personal only when a personal workspace exists; it also represents no workspace when setup is required. Path `me` selects the authenticated user; explicit user ids follow the existing user-route access rules.

post.description: Create a chat room. `kind: "channel"` requires an active organization and a user session. `kind: "direct"` creates or returns a direct room (self, 1:1 or multi-human group). Exactly the caller’s user ID and no AI targets opens one private Self Direct across workspaces, without requiring a personal workspace. Human 1:1 is an Org Direct when both people are Members of the active organization; otherwise a Personal Direct when they share an External channel roster. Multi-human groups still require an active organization. Coworker API keys may create-or-get an org-scoped coworker 1:1 with `{ kind: "direct", memberUserIds: [targetUserId] }` when the coworker is usable in that workspace; they cannot create channels, human Directs, groups, or personal coworker 1:1s. User-started coworker DMs may be personal (`organizationId` null) with no active org.

post.description:
Mint a direct upload session for a room chat attachment.
Caller must be an active (non-archived) room member, either a user session or a coworker API key.
Bytes go client to Vercel Blob (not through this API).
Put the public Blob URL into message markdown. No ChatFile row.

Paths:
- User: `users/{userId}/chats/{roomId}/…`
- Coworker: `coworkers/{coworkerId}/chats/{roomId}/…`

Flow:
1. POST this endpoint with `filename`, `contentType`, and `size`.
2. PUT raw bytes to `data.uploadUrl` with `Content-Type` from `data.headers`.
3. Insert the public URL into `POST …/messages` content.

Max size: 104857600 bytes. MIME allowlist matches user uploads.

201.description: Room chat file upload session created

post.description:
Mint a direct upload session for a drive file (personal or organization).
Bytes go client → Vercel Blob (not through this API).
Drive uses exact pathnames (addRandomSuffix: false).
409 if target pathname already exists.

Agent / REST:
1. POST this endpoint with `filename`, `contentType`, `size`, and `scope` (+ `organizationId` if scope=org).
2. PUT raw bytes to `uploadUrl` with `Content-Type` from `headers`.
3. Done — file is immediately available via pathname.

Max size: 104857600 bytes. MIME allowlist matches user uploads (including SVG for drive).

List drive items (folders and files) at the current folder level.
Personal or organization scope.

post.description: Self-join an active channel in the active organization. Public and external channels are joinable by any org member; private channels by organization owners and admins only. Idempotent when already a member. If the caller is already a guest and is now a host-org member, upgrades access to member. Unknown, wrong-org, direct, archived, or private-for-plain-member rooms return 404 (or 400 when the locked row is no longer joinable). External-channel guests join via room invitation, not this endpoint.

delete.description: Leave a chat room. Removes only the caller's membership and read marker; the room and its messages stay for everyone else. Any member can leave. The last member of an organization room cannot leave (ask an owner/admin to archive). The last member of an org-less matched channel may leave; the room is soft-archived in the same transaction. Direct rooms cannot be left.

patch.description: Update an organization chat room and its roster.

delete.description: Permanently delete a soft-archived organization chat room. Removes the room row and cascaded members, messages, and read states. Only an organization owner or admin may delete. The room must already be archived. Direct rooms cannot be deleted this way.

post.description: Archive an organization chat room. Every read filters on archivedAt, so it disappears for all members while its messages stay in the database. Only an organization owner/admin may archive. Direct rooms cannot be archived.

Restore a soft-archived organization chat room. Clears archivedAt so the room reappears for remaining members while keeping its existing slug. Only an organization owner/admin may restore. Direct rooms cannot be restored because they cannot be archived.

unreadMentionCount.description: Unread @mention attentions for the current user in this room (CHAT notifications with referenceId=roomId). Cleared on mark-read.

starredAt.description: When the current user starred this room. Null when not starred.

pinnedMessageCount.description: Number of Pinned messages on this Channel. Always 0 for Directs.

mutedAt.description: When the current user muted this room. Null when unmuted. Muted rooms sort last, hide sidebar attention chrome, and skip CHAT mention notifications.

markedUnread.description: True when the current user marked this room unread. Cleared on mark-read.

peerInActiveOrganization.description: True when every other human on a Direct is a Member of the caller's active organization. False with no active organization.

ChatRoomAccess.description: Caller's membership on this room. Guests are not host-org members.

ChatRoomKind.description: Filter rooms by kind. Omit to list every room.

ChatRoomListStatus.description: Room visibility. `active` (default) lists live rooms; `archived` lists soft-archived channels the caller can restore (organization owner/admin, and still a member).

pinnedAt.description: When this message was pinned in its Channel. Null when not pinned or deleted; always null for Directs and thread replies.

unfurls.description: Link preview cards scraped from message URLs (absent while pending).

snippet.example: Can you summarize this launch risk?

roomId.description: Source room of a quote sent to the caller's Self Direct. Absent when the quoted message is in the same room.

reactors.description: First reactors by createdAt ascending (capped). count may exceed reactors.length.

description.example: A short summary of the page.

allOf.description: Room membership kind: `"member"` (host-org participant) or `"guest"` (external channel only).

content.example: @coworker:elena Can you summarize this launch risk?

mentionedSokoBotIds.description: Personal assistants addressed in the message.

mentionedUserIds.description: Human room members addressed in the message. Validated against room membership; does not create ChatRoomMention rows or AI dispatch.

parentMessageId.description: Root message ID when posting a threaded reply.

quote.description: Quote another message in the same room. Snapshot is stored in metadata.quote; does not set parentMessageId.

clientMessageId.description: Opaque client turn id. Retries of the same send reuse this so concurrent or replayed POSTs create at most one row per room (unique on roomId + clientMessageId).

organizationId.description: Organization id of the preferred workspace, or null for personal. GET resolves sign-in fallbacks and also returns null when no workspace exists; check workspace-access first. The key is required: send {"organizationId":null} for personal. Omitting it (`{}`) is 422.

hasPersonalWorkspace.description: Whether the user owns a personal workspace row

hasOrganizationMembership.description: Whether the user is a member of at least one organization

hasPendingOrganizationInvites.description: Whether the user has at least one non-expired pending organization invitation by email

WorkspaceGateStatus.description: Derived workspace gate: ready when the user has a personal workspace or any organization membership; pending-invites when they have neither but have non-expired pending organization invitations; identity-onboarding when they have neither and no pending org entry

kind.description: Creates a named org channel. memberUserIds/coworkerIds seed the initial roster; they do not limit discoverability. Public and external channels are org-discoverable and self-joinable by any member (GET /chats/rooms/discoverable, POST /chats/rooms/{id}/members/me). Private channels stay roster-only for plain members; organization owners and admins can still browse and self-join them. External channels also allow guest invites (owner/admin create only).

name.description: Channel display name (max 80). If omitted or blank, Core derives title-case words from the slug (`team-soko` → `Team Soko`).

slug.description: Required Channel slug (max 80 after sanitize). Core sanitizes with kebab rules and rejects missing, empty-after-sanitize, or over-long values. Unique among Channels in the organization.

topic.example: Launch planning with design and AI research partners

discoverability.description: Channel discoverability. Defaults to `"public"` (org-discoverable / joinable by any member). `"private"` keeps the channel roster-only for plain members; organization owners and admins can still browse and self-join. `"external"` is org-discoverable for host members; guests join only via room invitation (owner/admin create only).

memberUserIds.description: Organization member user IDs to add to the room.

coworkerIds.description: Marketplace AI coworker IDs to add to the room.

sokoBotIds.description: Personal assistant (Soko Bot) IDs to add to the room. Only the owner can add their assistant.

kind.description: Creates or returns a direct room: one or more humans (1:1 or multi-human group), exactly one marketplace coworker, or exactly one personal assistant (Soko Bot). Human, coworker, and Soko Bot targets cannot be mixed. Human 1:1 is an Org Direct when both are Members of the active organization; otherwise a Personal Direct when they share an External channel. Multi-human groups and coworker/Soko Bot DMs with an active org are org-scoped. Coworker and Soko Bot DMs may be personal with no active org. Coworker API keys may create-or-get an org-scoped coworker 1:1 with memberUserIds: [target] and no coworkerIds (the actor is the coworker). Discoverability is not allowed on directs.

memberUserIds.description: Organization member user IDs to add to the room.

coworkerIds.description: Marketplace AI coworker IDs to add to the room.

sokoBotIds.description: Personal assistant (Soko Bot) IDs to add to the room. Only the owner can add their assistant.

filename.description: Original file name supplied by the client

contentType.description: Declared MIME type. May be inferred from the filename when generic.

method.description: HTTP method for the client upload request

addRandomSuffix.description: Whether Blob appends a random suffix to the final pathname

scope.description: Owner scope: 'me' for personal drive, 'org' for organization drive

folder.description: Target folder path relative to scope root (empty/omit for root)

pathname.description: Server-generated upload pathname (no random suffix for Drive)

access.description: Blob access level for the upload

method.description: HTTP method for the client upload request

headers.description: Headers the client must send on the PUT

expiresAt.description: When the presigned upload URL expires (ISO-8601)

maxSizeBytes.description: Maximum supported file size for this upload policy

addRandomSuffix.description: Drive files use exact pathnames (no random suffix)

path.description: Relative folder path from current folder (single segment)

uploadedAt.description: When the file was uploaded to Blob storage

content.example: Fixed typo in the launch summary

pinnedAt.description: When this message was pinned in its Channel. Null when not pinned or deleted; always null for Directs and thread replies.

unfurls.description: Link preview cards scraped from message URLs (absent while pending).

pinnedMessageCount.description: Current number of Pinned messages on this Channel.

lastReplyAt.description: createdAt of the newest non-deleted reply.

unreadReplyCount.description: Non-deleted replies from others after the dual-baseline look, only when the viewer is a Participant (parent author, remaining reply, or remaining user mention) and has not muted this thread. Replies that name the viewer count even in a muted thread. Zero for lurkers, including never-looked lurkers.

lastUnreadReplyAt.description: createdAt of the newest qualifying unread reply, or null when none.

hasLooked.description: True when the viewer has a ChatRoomThreadReadState row for this parent. Never-looked threads are false even when replyCount > 0.

mutedAt.description: When the viewer muted this thread, or null when they have not. A muted thread stops counting toward room unread and stops writing CHAT notifications for them; replies that name them still do. Mute does not change whether they Participate.

count.description: Number of unread threads (`unreadReplyCount >= 1`, Participant-gated dual-baseline). Does not hydrate thread items.

markedCount.description: Number of parent threads whose look state was upserted.

channel.description: Where it is delivered: in the app, as an OS banner (which also needs pushOptIn), or by email (offered only on the categories that mail)

enabled.description: Whether the reader wants this category on this channel

priority.description: Sort priority for coworker lists. Higher numbers appear first.

baseURL.description: OpenAI Responses API base URL used to enable this coworker for chat.

capabilities.description: Enabled coworker capabilities. Empty array means the coworker has no enabled capabilities.

channels.description: Contact channels keyed by provider id (e.g. email, whatsapp).

offers.description: Curated, pre-filled task offers shown in the agents marketplace.

CoworkerProfile.description: Public agent profile shown in selection UIs (model, hosting, capabilities, examples).

prompt.example: Run a competitive analysis of my top 3 competitors and summarize their positioning.

description.example: A sourced, side-by-side breakdown of your top competitors — positioning, pricing, strengths, and the gaps you can exploit.

deliverable.example: A 2–3 page PDF brief with a comparison table and key takeaways.

type.description: Output kind. Common file extensions are accepted and normalized (e.g. docx→doc, pptx→slides, xlsx/xls/csv→sheet, png/jpg→image).

text.description: Inline example content shown when there is no file URL. For `text` outputs this is Markdown; for `html` outputs it is a full HTML document rendered in a sandboxed iframe. `html` outputs may instead point at a hosted page via `url`.

outputs.description: Example outputs the offer produces — text and/or files (PDF, document, slides, spreadsheet, image, html). Multiple outputs render as switchable tabs in the preview.

lastSeenAt.description: Most recent session activity for the member (max Session.updatedAt); null if the member has never had a session.

status.description: Whether the sanitized Channel slug is free among Channels in the active organization, including private and archived Channels. Does not identify the occupant.

DiscoverableChannelDiscoverability.description: `"public"` and `"external"` for every org member; `"private"` only for organization owners and admins. Never `"matched"`.

slug.description: Rejected. Channel slug is immutable after create.

topic.example: Launch planning with design and AI research partners

memberUserIds.description: Host-org roster rewrite. Existing guest members are room-scoped and survive this field: ids already `access=guest` on the room are ignored (not 400) unless they are now organization members, in which case they upgrade to `access=member`. Omit a guest to keep them. Do not use this field to add or remove guests.

sokoBotIds.description: Personal assistant roster rewrite. Only the owner can add their assistant; anyone who can edit the roster may keep or remove existing ones.

OrgChannelDiscoverability.description: Update channel discoverability. `"public"` makes the channel org-discoverable and self-joinable by any member; `"private"` hides it from the discoverable listing for plain members (organization owners/admins still see and can join it); `"external"` is org-discoverable for host members with guest invites. Converting away from `"external"` is blocked while guest members or pending invites exist.

remainingUserMemberCount.description: Human members left in the room after the caller leaves. Zero only for org-less matched channels, which auto-archive when the last member leaves. Organization rooms keep the last member (archive instead).
